questions.explain: Plitvice Lakes, Croatia. It is a national park in Croatia. It has 16 terraced lakes joined by waterfalls.

questions.prompt: In which country is Persepolis?
questions.explain: Persepolis, Iran. Its ruins are near Shiraz. It was the ceremonial capital of the Achaemenid Empire.

questions.prompt: In which country is Sigiriya?
questions.explain: Sigiriya, Sri Lanka. It is a rock fortress in central Sri Lanka. A palace once stood on its flat top.

questions.prompt: In which country is the Château Frontenac?
questions.explain: Château Frontenac, Canada. It overlooks the St. Lawrence River in Quebec City. Its copper roofs have turned green.

questions.prompt: In which country is the White House?
questions.explain: White House, United States. It is the home and office of the US president in Washington, D.C. Its address is 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue.

questions.prompt: In which country is the Ngorongoro Crater?
questions.explain: Ngorongoro Crater, Tanzania. It is in northern Tanzania near the Serengeti. It is the world's largest unbroken volcanic caldera that is not filled with water.

questions.prompt: In which country is the Hassan II Mosque?
questions.explain: Hassan II Mosque, Morocco. It is in Casablanca. Part of its floor is built over the Atlantic Ocean.

questions.prompt: In which country is Carthage?
questions.explain: Carthage, Tunisia. Its ruins lie near Tunis. It was founded by Phoenicians.

questions.prompt: In which country is Leptis Magna?
questions.explain: Leptis Magna, Libya. It is on the coast of Libya. Its ruins are among the best-preserved Roman sites in the Mediterranean.
